subject: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Hi Elena —

Following our call, attaching the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a small sample manifest so your team can sanity-check the formats we expect. Key asks in this email:

- Confirm the subset of test cases you want included in the pilot (we suggested 200 prioritized retail checkout and returns scenarios).
- Confirm retention window for ephemeral promptpacks (we default to 30 days unless you request 14 days).
- Any additional compliance evidence you need before we ship (SOC2 artifact pointers are in the MAP appendix).

Attachments: MAP-BR-2026-11-draft.pdf (draft MAP with milestones), BR_evals_v1_sample_manifest.csv (file list & metadata).

Planned next steps: if you OK the MAP draft, we can run a 2-week onboarding sprint: week 1 — ingest & smoke tests in your sandbox; week 2 — joint QA and acceptance gate. Proposed transfer method is SFTP (we have short-lived credentials) or secure Drive the first time.

Cc'ing Karthik for the rollout cadence and Laura for the retention/ops checklist.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Ben —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments. A few notes from evaluation:

- Sample manifest looks good, but we need category-level anonymization on user IDs before anything leaves our systems (we can provide a hashing salt or you can apply a one-way hash; preference is ours to provide).
- Retention: Procurement wants 14 days for ephemeral promptpacks; Ops prefers 30 for troubleshooting. Can we make retention configurable per-package?
- Evidence: SOC2 report is sufficient for initial pilots; for production we will expect a signed AUP appendix.

We’ll confirm the exact list of 200 scenarios by Monday. Procurement (cc'd) will follow up on PO and standard MSAs.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product Initiatives — BrightRetail
elena@brightretail.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Elena / team —

We can support per-package retention windows. Operationally that will look like:

- Short-lived promptpacks: retention configurable at 14 / 30 / 60 days in the staging workflow.
- We will persist only derived artifacts (tokenized embeddings and QA traces) for the selected retention window; raw PII fields will be hashed/stripped before transfer.
- We will provide the hash algorithm and a test vector so you can verify reversibility is impossible.

Action items for next steps:
1) BrightRetail to confirm preferred anonymization approach (you provide salt or we hash with industry-standard SHA-256 and store no salt).
2) BrightRetail to confirm the final scenario list by EOD Monday (we need it to size ingest).
3) Redwood to send SFTP credentials and a one-time onboarding checklist once MAP is signed.

Laura — can you confirm the SFTP credential TTL and key rotation cadence we should propose in the MAP appendix?

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Team —

SFTP / key rotation notes:

- We will provision one-time SFTP credentials valid for 7 days for the initial ingest.
- If you prefer continuous sync we can set up per-folder SSH keys with 30-day rotation.
- All uploads are scanned and then deleted from the staging host once ingested and verified; persistent copies live only in the sandbox sandbox-bb-01 with the agreed retention.

Regarding the MAP appendix: I included a short list of SOC2 artifacts and a template AUP clause (attaches in Ben's MAP draft). If Procurement requires a stronger commitment we can surface it as an addendum.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Hi all —

Procurement here. Quick clarifications before we issue a PO: 

- We require a 30-day cancellation clause for pilots unless explicit written extension is agreed.
- Please confirm the exact delivery SLA for handoff (we need file-level manifest + checksum within 48 hours of transfer completion).
- We prefer DocuSign for the MAP and MSA addendum. Can you send the DocuSign link?

Once we have these answers, we will route the PO and expect signature within 3 business days.

— Maria Alvarez (on behalf of BrightRetail Procurement)
procurement@brightretail.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightretail.com>, BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment kit finalization & data safeguards for BrightRetail MAP

Maria / Elena —

Thanks — confirmed items below: 

- Cancellation: pilot includes a 30-day termination right for either party; we will add explicit language to the MAP addendum.
- Delivery SLA: we will provide the manifest + SHA256 checksums within 24 hours of successful ingestion and verification.
- DocuSign: sending the MAP + MSA addendum now — link below. Please sign the MAP to trigger credential provisioning.

DocuSign (MAP + addendum): https://www.docusign.com/BR-2026-11/MAP
SFTP onboarding note (one-time credentials, 7d TTL) attached: SFTP_instructions.txt

If you sign today we can run the initial ingest next Tuesday and target acceptance gate the week after.

Looking forward,
Ben
